verdict.rationale: Codegen supports several built-in event-triggered automations (CI/CD failure triggers, PR review-on-failure comments, agent responding only to explicit mentions, auto-creating tasks from workspace events), showing some automation-on-event capability. But there's no evidence of a general-purpose rules engine where users define arbitrary custom conditions/actions across events. Missing for 10: a configurable rules/trigger builder, support for user-defined arbitrary event conditions, and independent confirmation beyond vendor docs.
